name: England Exchange
source:
As a participant in our Study Abroad programme, you will have access to a wide variety of modules across all departments to suit your degree needs back in America. You will be guaranteed housing in a student hostel, where shared living and kitchen facilities will promote interaction between residents from different countries and backgrounds. You will also be assigned part-time employment for your financial needs and to help you experience an authentic British life.

We look forward to welcoming you in London!
translation:
參加交換留學計畫期間，你可以選修各系提供的各種課程，以取得在美國修讀學位所需的學分。本計畫保證提供學生宿舍，公共生活區和廚房會促進來自不同國家、擁有不同背景的學生交流。你還會獲得一份兼職工作，可以補貼生活費，同時體驗正宗的英國生活。

我們期待在倫敦歡迎你！
